scope: theory review only; implementation execution gate remains separate
arguments: For exact unit generators and nonzero u, c=min(u dot r)>0 implies u dot sum(alpha r)>=c sum alpha>=c norm(sum alpha r). The represented positive hull lies in the spherical cap.

The cap mass is .5 I_(1-c^2)((d-1)/2,.5); d2 orthant equals1/4 and d3 orthant upper(1-1/sqrt3)/2 exceeds1/8. Undefined sum direction must not be silently accepted as an upper bound; c<=0 fallback1 is safe.

For e=2^-30 the positive box x1 in[1,2],x2,x3 in[e/8,e/4] lies strictly in the narrow positive hull; volume e^2/64 and density>1/648 yield mass>e^2/41472. Source-floating normalized directions must be independently bound to these exact directions.
budget_qualifications: Mass bounds require represented-hull coverage of the relevant cells and proper partition/multiplicity accounting.
Ideal replacement of a classifier label changes error by at most cell mass; sum of genuine upper bounds bounds ideal total replacement discrepancy.
Actual wrong-centroid path uses estT.mass; its floating numerical error, retained recipe error and floating accumulation of P.bound are not certified by exact cap containment.
Single-split counterfactual differences need not add to joint pruning error.
Four analytic controls are appropriate finite discriminators, not a universal numerical failure or trained-panel accuracy claim.
